title: Shadow Protocol
description: A retired intelligence analyst is pulled back into the field when a coded message from her past resurfaces, threatening a global summit.

title: Crimson Sky
description: A smokejumper races a wildfire up a mountain ridge while uncovering an arson conspiracy burning through her own crew.

title: The Last Ember
description: Three generations of a glassblowing family confront the closure of the workshop that defined their town.

title: Neon Harbor
description: In a rain-soaked port city, a courier smuggling memories discovers a shipment that could rewrite the city's identity registry.

title: Midnight Runner
description: An ultramarathoner witnesses a crime mid-race and spends one long night outrunning both the culprits and the police.

title: Quiet Waters
description: A widow returns to her lakeside childhood home and slowly rebuilds a life among the neighbors she once left behind.

title: Paper Moons
description: Two rival greeting-card writers accidentally co-author a bestseller without realizing they can't stand each other.

title: The Great Charade
description: A washed-up stage magician cons his way into a high-society heist crew, where the only trick is staying in character.

title: Laughing Matters
description: A failing open-mic comedian takes a day job as a funeral eulogist and discovers she is funnier at goodbyes.

title: Orbital Drift
description: The crew of a decommissioned space station must improvise a rescue when a passing vessel's AI refuses to let them dock.

title: The Second Earth
description: An astronomer detects a planet identical to our own and must decide whether first contact is an invitation or an invasion.

title: Signal Lost
description: A remote listening post intercepts a broadcast of its own team's final transmission, dated one week in the future.

title: Glass Cage
description: A jury sequestered in a glass tower begins suspecting one of their own is steering the verdict of a blockbuster trial.

title: The Vanishing Hour
description: A clockmaker's daughter loses sixty minutes of memory each night and pieces together the crime hidden inside them.

title: Cold Verdict
description: A small-town judge presides over a case connected to her own buried past, and the evidence is closing in.

title: Heartline
description: A cardiologist and a pacemaker engineer keep meeting in hospital corridors while arguing about the shape of a valve.

title: Iron Range
description: A mining-town boxer takes one last fight against the company that owns the ring, the gym, and half the town.

title: Deep Static
description: A radio DJ's overnight show starts taking calls from a frequency that shouldn't exist, and the voice knows her name.

title: Starlight Cafe
description: The last diner at the edge of a highway becomes a midnight sanctuary for a mismatched crew of regulars.

title: Rogue Meridian
description: A cartographer of shifting borders discovers a corridor on the map that appears only once a decade, and someone is willing to kill to walk it.

title: Crown of Ash
description: After the palace burns, a reluctant heir rebuilds a kingdom out of rivals, spies, and one very patient accountant.

title: Nightshift
description: The overnight staff of a 24-hour precinct solve the crimes nobody wants to claim before the sun comes up.

title: Pixel Perfect
description: A struggling indie game studio bickers its way from garage prototype to improbable blockbuster, one deadline at a time.

title: The Long Orbit
description: A generational cargo ship's youngest crew member uncovers why the voyage has lasted three centuries longer than planned.

title: Dead Frequency
description: Coast guard operators in a fog-bound station trace distress calls from ships that sank fifty years ago.

title: Family Recipe
description: Four siblings inherit a restaurant and a recipe book where every dish hides a family secret worth fighting over.

title: Quantum Grove
description: A botanist discovers her greenhouse grows plants from alternate timelines, and the neighbors have started to notice.

title: The Silent Witness
description: A forensic sketch artist who can hear the memories of the deceased helps close cases she was never meant to know about.

title: Bright Falls
description: A traveling nurse takes a temporary post in a small mountain town that has no intention of letting her leave.

title: Counter Play
description: An international chess champion trades the board for the underworld, where every move has already been predicted.

title: Winterheat
description: Two rival ski instructors share a gondola, a small town, and a bet neither of them wants to win anymore.

title: The Understudy
description: A perpetual second-choice actress finally gets her shot when the lead vanishes, and comedy ensues trying to keep it that way.
